subject: english

topics.topic: Broad aims: listening, speaking, reading and writing
covers: Listen for cues and draw inferences
Speak to discuss ideas logically and creatively
Read independently, infer meaning and read critically
Write clearly and in an organised way for different purposes
Fables from Aesop, the Panchatantra and the Jatakas
Picture-led stories such as Peter Rabbit, Noddy and Pinocchio
Reading aloud, silently and in groups
Completing a story and picture composition
Recording a process, such as making a sandwich
Simple comprehension on seen and unseen passages
Spelling, word search and word games
Writing for the school magazine, newsletters and soft boards

gaps: Only recommended reading and activities were found; no per-class grammar, oral or writing topics.
